spatialReload.notes: Movement-only testbed built from the exact known-good learner paths. It never owns a reload clip, ammo, visibility, or gameplay.

groups.notes: The physical bolt mesh selects three independent top-level rig drivers. Descendant meshes ride those drivers; no connector is driven.
BSX is the physical OMOD-backed grip. WeaponMagazine is the sole top-level driver and carries the complete magazine subtree through P-Mag.
